How to use the spreadsheet: 'Ctrl F' to search for any champion. To sort by patch/time, select the entire sheet, use 'sort range', then select the category to sort by.

*Recall clear note*: All S16 Clears using homeguard are currently bugged in practice tool and are ~3 seconds faster than in real games.
Note: the spreadsheet is not complete, more paths/champions will be added in time, you can find old clears from season 15 by going to sheet 2 at the bottom, 
These are just demonstrations of clears and not the only viable paths on these champions.
The spreadsheet has 6 parts, 'Meta junglers', 'Off-Meta junglers', 'Non-Meta junglers', 'Outdated Clears', 'Helpful Resources', 'Appendix'. Find them by scrolling down.  
Runes are often found in video. Find more details/alternative versions of a clear in the notes/details section.
